distinguishing_features: A passive solid high-permittivity stress-relief sleeve is placed at slot exits and terminations.
The candidate directly modifies local electric-field stress instead of monitoring or inferring degradation.
The candidate targets PD inception during voltage spikes via material/geometry field grading.
No sensors, telemetry, or predictive algorithm are required.
parsed.objective_technical_problem: How to suppress partial-discharge initiation in motor windings subjected to voltage spikes by controlling local electric-field stress at vulnerable insulation regions.
parsed.viable_reason: As written, the ε-contrast rationale is physically unsound because a higher-ε medium around an air void raises E_void under D_n continuity, and the stated kill criterion is inverted, so the proposed validation cannot establish the alleged suppression.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: The distinguishing features amount to applying known stator stress-grading material/physics to known slot-exit and termination high-field locations with routine ε selection, which would be obvious to a skilled engineer.
